title: Crypto traders can now hedge Nvidia, Anthropic and oil bets on Derive
summary: Derive’s new options on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices and oil bring hedging tools to onchain RWA markets.
content: Derive has launched new options that allow crypto traders to hedge their positions on Nvidia, Anthropic, stock indices, and oil. This development brings advanced hedging tools to onchain real-world asset markets, giving decentralized finance participants more ways to manage risk across traditional and digital financial instruments.
content_ta: Crypto வர்த்தகர்கள் Nvidia, Anthropic, பங்குச் சந்தை குறியீடுகள் மற்றும் oil மீதான தங்கள் முதலீடுகளுக்கு Derive-ல் hedging செய்து கொள்ள புதிய options வசதிகள் அறிமுகப்படுத்தப்பட்டுள்ளன. இந்த புதிய வசதி onchain RWA சந்தைகளுக்கு மேம்பட்ட hedging கருவிகளை கொண்டு வந்துள்ளது.

title: A year after buying bitcoin, Czech central bank won't say what it's worth
summary: The Czech National Bank bought bitcoin a year ago as an experiment. The coin has fallen at least 40% since, and the bank's audited accounts carry it at cost rather than market value. The CNB told CoinDesk an outside custodian holds the coins.
content: A year after purchasing bitcoin as an experiment, the Czech National Bank has declined to disclose the current value of its holdings. Following a significant decline in the cryptocurrency's price, the bank continues to report the asset at its original cost in its audited accounts. An outside custodian currently holds the coins for the bank.
content_ta: ஒரு வருடத்திற்கு முன்பு பரிசோதனை முயற்சியாக bitcoin வாங்கிய Czech National Bank, தற்போது தனது முதலீட்டின் தற்போதைய மதிப்பு குறித்த விவரங்களை வெளியிட மறுத்துவிட்டது. கிரிப்டோகரன்சியின் விலை கணிசமாகக் குறைந்துள்ள நிலையில், வங்கி தனது தணிக்கை செய்யப்பட்ட கணக்குகளில் இந்த சொத்தை வாங்கிய விலையிலேயே தொடர்ந்து காட்டி வருகிறது. தற்போது இந்த நாணயங்களை வெளிநாட்டு காப்பாளர் ஒருவர் வைத்துள்ளார்.

title: Global Digital Asset and Structured Finance Platform OpenVault Completes $2 Million Seed Round at $20 Million Post-Money Valuation
summary: Round led by HorizonArc Ventures; proceeds to fund AI technology, product expansion, compliance and global growth Global digital asset and structured finance platform OpenVault today announced the completion of a $2 million seed round led by HorizonArc Ventures, with a post-money valuation of $20 million. The proceeds will be primarily used for AI technology development, product portfolio expansion, compliance infrastructure, and global market growth. A One-Stop Gateway for Digital Asset Yield OpenVault is an innovative financial platform focused on digital asset yield management, RWA (real-world assets), and structured financial products. Through its standardized Vault architecture, the platform integrates stablecoin yield, quantitative investment strategies, and diversified asset allocation, providing global users with a transparent, efficient, one-stop digital asset investment gateway. AI-Powered, Lower Barriers to Entry Powered by its proprietary AI engine, OpenVault significantly lowers the barrier to participation: AI Smart Recommendation and Auto-Subscription: Based on users’ risk preferences, asset profiles, and market conditions, the system automatically matches and subscribes to suitable products. Users can enable a “stable yield” mode with one click, achieving true set-and-forget management. Stable Yield Product Suite: Includes high-yield stablecoin Vaults, market-neutral quantitative strategies, RWA yield products, and more, with a strong focus on risk control and return stability, designed for users seeking steady capital appreciation. BTC FCN and Other Structured Products: Offers Bitcoin-linked Fixed Coupon Notes (FCN) and other structured financial products, allowing users to capture potential BTC upside while benefiting from downside protection and fixed coupon features, balancing return potential and risk. End-to-End AI-Assisted Management: From product selection and automatic reinvestment to risk monitoring and yield rebalancing, AI is involved throughout the process, greatly improving operational convenience and decision-making efficiency. Making Structured Finance Accessible With “standardized Vault + AI-driven” as its core, OpenVault aims to turn complex digital asset and structured finance products into user-friendly tools accessible to ordinary investors. The platform emphasizes asset transparency, strategy traceability, and quantifiable risk control, striving to deliver a more robust and intelligent wealth management experience in the digital asset space. About OpenVault OpenVault is an innovative financial platform focused on digital asset yield management, RWA (real-world assets), and structured financial products. The platform emphasizes asset transparency, strategy traceability, and quantifiable risk control. Website: openvault.club Media Contact Elowen OpenVault Email: elowen960323@gmail.com
content: Global digital asset and structured finance platform OpenVault has successfully completed a $2 million seed funding round led by HorizonArc Ventures, bringing its post-money valuation to $20 million. The company plans to use the capital to advance its AI technology, expand its product portfolio, strengthen compliance infrastructure, and drive global growth. OpenVault focuses on digital asset yield management, RWA, and structured products.
content_ta: குளோபல் டிஜிட்டல் அசெட் மற்றும் கட்டமைக்கப்பட்ட நிதி தளமான OpenVault, HorizonArc Ventures தலைமையிலான $2 மில்லியன் சீட் ஃபண்டிங் ரவுண்டை வெற்றிகரமாக முடித்துள்ளது, இதன் மூலம் அதன் மதிப்பீடு $20 மில்லியனாக உயர்ந்துள்ளது. ஏஐ தொழில்நுட்பத்தை மேம்படுத்தவும், தயாரிப்பு போர்ட்ஃபோலியோவை விரிவுபடுத்தவும், இணக்க உள்கட்டமைப்பை வலுப்படுத்தவும் இந்த நிதி பயன்படுத்தப்படவுள்ளது. OpenVault ஆனது டிஜிட்டல் அசெட் ஈல்ட் மேனேஜ்மென்ட் மற்றும் கட்டமைக்கப்பட்ட நிதி தயாரிப்புகளில் கவனம் செலுத்துகிறது.

title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
summary: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.
content: Donald Trump has stated he is willing to pardon Jensen Huang, though he believes it will not be necessary. These remarks follow upcoming congressional questioning regarding national security concerns and US chip export controls.
content_ta: Jensen Huang-க்கு pardon வழங்க தான் தயாராக இருப்பதாக Donald Trump தெரிவித்துள்ளார், இருப்பினும் அது அவசியமாக இருக்காது என்றும் அவர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். தேசிய பாதுகாப்பு கவலைகள் மற்றும் US chip ஏற்றுமதி கட்டுப்பாடுகள் குறித்த நாடாளுமன்றத்தின் விசாரணைக்கு Jensen Huang முகங்கொடுக்கவுள்ள நிலையில் இந்த கருத்துக்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன.

title: Signal tightens restrictions on AI agents that read your screen
summary:
Signal's new restrictions highlight the growing tension between privacy-focused apps and OS-level AI, urging tech giants to enhance data control.
The post Signal tightens restrictions on AI agents that read your screen appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Signal has introduced new restrictions targeting AI agents that can read user screens. This update highlights the ongoing tension between privacy-focused applications and operating system-level artificial intelligence. The move emphasizes the need for major tech companies to provide users with better data control and privacy protection as AI integration expands.
content_ta: யூசர்களின் ஸ்கிரீன்களைப் படிக்கும் AI ஏஜெண்டுகளுக்கு எதிராக Signal புதிய கட்டுப்பாடுகளை விதித்துள்ளது. தனியுரிமைக்கு முக்கியத்துவம் அளிக்கும் ஆப்களுக்கும் OS-நிலை செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவுகளுக்கும் இடையேயான மோதலை இந்த நடவடிக்கை காட்டுகிறது. AI பயன்பாடு அதிகரிக்கும் வேளையில், சிறந்த தரவுக் கட்டுப்பாட்டை வழங்குமாறு முன்னணி டெக் நிறுவனங்களை இது வலியுறுத்துகிறது.

title: CleanSpark posts $987 million fiscal 2026 loss, holds 11,720 Bitcoin
summary:
CleanSpark's significant fiscal loss amid Bitcoin holdings highlights the volatility and financial risks inherent in cryptocurrency investments.

content: Bitcoin mining company CleanSpark has reported a significant fiscal 2026 loss of $987 million. This development highlights the ongoing financial volatility and market risks associated with corporate cryptocurrency holdings in the digital asset sector.

Huang reportedly said he now spends 90 minutes a day in therapy and acknowledged that his management style has hurt and belittled employees. He also pledged to keep …

He acknowledged that his past management style had sometimes hurt and belittled employees. To address this and improve, Huang revealed that he now dedicates a significant amount of time each day to therapy sessions.

title: Trump says he's willing to give Nvidia's Huang a pardon, doesn't think he needs one
summary: President Donald Trump said in an interview with the New York Post that he's fine clearing Nvidia's CEO from legal trouble in his affair scandal.
content: President Donald Trump stated in an interview that he is willing to offer a pardon to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang regarding an affair scandal, though he noted he does not believe Huang requires one. The comments emerged during a discussion about potential legal issues, highlighting Trump's stance on the matter.
